name: 层级树/分类树

prompt_template.subject: {hierarchy_topic}
prompt_template.layout: top-down tree with root at top and branches expanding downward
prompt_template.style: clean dendrogram with rectangular or curved branches
prompt_template.color_scheme: root in primary color, branches color-coded by category
prompt_template.labels: root and internal nodes in semibold, leaf nodes in regular, taxonomic ranks in italic

overrides.style: rectangular dendrogram with right-angle branches and bootstrap values

overrides.layout: radial tree with root at center and branches radiating outward
top-down org chart with rectangular nodes and vertical/horizontal connectors

overrides.style: decision tree with diamond decision nodes, rectangular outcome nodes, and condition labels on edges

category_tips.biology: 分类学按界门纲目科属种；系统发育树标 bootstrap 值；分支长度反映演化距离
category_tips.medicine: 疾病分类按 ICD；诊断决策树标敏感度/特异度；家谱标遗传模式
category_tips.chemistry: 物质分类按元素/化合物/混合物；有机物按官能团；反应按类型
category_tips.physics: 粒子分类按费米子/玻色子；力按四种基本力；波按机械/电磁
category_tips.engineering: 系统分解按功能模块；故障树按 FTA；零件按 BOM 层级
category_tips.math: 数系分类按自然/整数/有理/实数/复数；几何按欧氏/非欧；分布按离散/连续

examples: Phylogenetic tree of vertebrates, top-down rectangular dendrogram. Root: Vertebrata 脊椎动物门. Branches: Fish 鱼类, Amphibia 两栖类, Reptilia 爬行类, Aves 鸟类, Mammalia 哺乳类. Bootstrap values at nodes. Branch lengths proportional to evolutionary distance. Root brown #92400e, branches distinct hues. Taxonomic ranks italic. Bilingual labels. 4K, publication-ready.

Taxonomy hierarchy of Homo sapiens, top-down tree: Domain Eukarya -> Kingdom Animalia -> Phylum Chordata -> Class Mammalia -> Order Primates -> Family Hominidae -> Genus Homo -> Species H. sapiens. Each rank in box, latin names italic, common names bilingual 人类 (Human). Root blue #2563eb. 4K, textbook style.

Decision tree for medical diagnosis, top-down. Root: Patient symptoms. Decision diamonds: Fever? -> Cough? -> ... Outcome rectangles: Common Cold, Flu, COVID-19, Pneumonia. Condition labels on edges (Yes/No, temperature ranges). Sensitivity/specificity at nodes. Green #10b981 for benign, red #ef4444 for severe outcomes. 4K.
accuracy_tips: 分类层级符合学科标准（生物按界门纲目科属种）；分支节点同属一个分类层级；不虚构分类关系；系统发育树标 bootstrap 值；分支长度有依据；拉丁学名斜体；中英文对照准确。
